**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP).**

- **Structure is good:** §21.1 cap is expressly mutual; §21.2 mutually excludes indirect/consequential damages and confirms data-restoration, replacement-service, notice and incident-response costs are direct; §21.3 carves out confidentiality, data-protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and the other party's IP, and confirms Customer's payment obligations are not capped damages.
- **The failure is the cap base:** "Fees" is defined (1.5/1.6) as only the one-time **USD 12,000 Implementation Fee** under the first Order Form, so the twelve-month look-back captures no subscription or services charges — an illusory cap well below even 6 months of real fees, which the rule treats as walk-away.
- **Redline (validated):** cap becomes the greater of (a) all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement and all Order Forms in the preceding 12 months and (b) USD 1,000,000, with carve-outs untouched.
